features: Normal native telephony call priority guarantee (no forced radio lock)
6-phase telephony lifecycle (idle, incoming_call, outgoing_call, active_call, rechecking_network, resuming_browsing)
In-call priority notification banner with active call controls
Automated post-call network re-check and browsing recovery
Secure URL navigation & smart protocol auto-inference
Clean, tracker-free, zero-ad search aggregator (Wikipedia OpenSearch & DDG instant answers)
Input validation & SSRF protection (rejection of localhost, 127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, javascript:, file:)
AbortController-powered loading cancellation ('X' header button & 'Cancel' in loader)
Fault-tolerant error recovery ('Retry in Text-First Mode' & 'Return to Start Page')
Full bidirectional Back/Forward history stack preservation
In-app anchor click trapping with relative URL base resolution
Safe request failure detection across connection interruptions and unreachable hosts
12-second request timeout handling with clean 504 gateway timeout responses
Context-aware, user-friendly recovery states tailored to specific destination domains
Multi-tier retry mechanisms (Standard retry and Ultra Low Bandwidth text-first retry)
History state and loaded content preservation (option to keep viewing loaded page without losing state)
Full prevention of raw stack traces, technical error codes, and sensitive server details
Strict isolation preserving CALL-SAFE telephony recheck logic and lifecycle intact
